from pathlib import PurePosixPath

def is_lightweight(raw):
    path = PurePosixPath(raw)
    if path.is_absolute() or '..' in path.parts or not path.parts:
        return False
    if path.parts[0] in {'docs', '.kos'}:
        return True
    return len(path.parts) == 1 and path.suffix.lower() == '.md'

paths = [
    'Keyboard/Controllers/KeyboardViewController.swift',
    'Keyboard/Controllers/KeyboardViewController+Bootstrap.swift',
    'Keyboard/Services/KeyboardHostLifecycleRecoveryGate.swift',
    'KeyboardTests/KeyboardHostLifecycleRecoveryGateTests.swift',
    'Universe Keyboard.xcodeproj/project.pbxproj',
    'docs/evidence/keyboard-wake-host-activation-fix-001-f2-prepared-entry-2026-10-04.md',
]
full = [p for p in paths if not is_lightweight(p)]
print('classification=full' if full else 'classification=docs_only')
print('requires_full=' + ('true' if full else 'false'))
print('full_required_paths=' + ','.join(full))
print('reason=uncommitted_f1_source_is_full_by_frozen_table')
if not full:
    raise SystemExit(2)

    'Keyboard/Services/KeyboardHostLifecycleRecoveryGate.swift',

]

    result = subprocess.run(
        ['git', 'diff', '--check', '--no-index', '--', '/dev/null', file],
        capture_output=True, text=True,
